purpose: Test whether Barron et al. 2026 A Fix for Softmax and Cross-Entropy changes Mirror-generated virtual attention experts in regimes deliberately sensitive to softmax collapse and teacher-student cancellation; separate generic numerical improvement from Mirror-specific benefit.
units: Loss reported in nats per query. Synthetic normalized logits and parameters are dimensionless. Wall seconds are observed, not fixed clock.

setup.teacher: Fixed world/seed-specific attention map; rule ID supplied to student (oracle routing) as in prior exploration. Labels in hard lane are top-1 teacher retrieval, not original dense teacher probabilities.
setup.generator: Torch CPU RNG, split-specific seeds train/dev/fresh/ood. Fresh/OOD not generated before all checkpoints hash-frozen.

lane_hard_ce.fixed_ce: Barron hard-target exact-margin expression softplus(logsumexp(non-target logits minus target logit)).
lane_hard_ce.caveat: High logit scale is intentionally adversarial. It is not evidence of what happens in ordinary Transformers. Independent expert is a larger upper control.

lane_distillation.teacher_source: same-world same-seed fixed_ce-trained high-logit-scale 12.0 model from the hard lane; student initialized as exact parameter copy of teacher
lane_distillation.fixed_soft_ce: Barron et al. eq. 9: use teacher logits and log ratio delta, expm1/log1p, enforce zero-sum backward, keep original standard forward value. Implemented with detach-gradient surrogate; no teacher gradients.
lane_distillation.caveat: Trivially identical student teacher is numerical invariance test, NOT ability to learn a distinct compressed student.

properties: gradient sums to zero to finite precision
householder Q/K simultaneous rotation attention-score invariance
lane_numeric.note: Standalone attention softmax to be checked separately; high beta CE lane does not automatically fix SDPA internals.

success_gates.numeric: at fp32 [9,-9,-9] fixed target grad nonzero close to fp64; exact-match soft target fixed max logit gradient zero; tests pass
success_gates.hard_ce: within Mirror arm fixed CE achieves at least 5% lower fresh FP64 CE than standard CE in 4/6 paired world-seeds in high-scale group; must report equivalent control outcomes separately
success_gates.distillation: in at least 5/6 world-seeds for mirror eps=1e-8, fixed soft CE fresh teacher-student KL is lower than standard (tolerance 1e-9 nat/query), with exact logit-match zero gradient
success_gates.mirror_specific: in at least 4/6 world-seeds, fixed-ce improvement fraction for Mirror exceeds same-88-parameter FiLM by 5 percentage points; no unconditional Mirror superiority without this
success_gates.adoption: numeric pass and prospective quality gate pass versus matched control at accounting of bytes/training compute; hard-only or distill-only signal is scoped not architecture win

integrity.comparison_warning: Contrast training stability against control at matched updates and real CPU time. Previous MA-1173, MA-1175, MA-1176 failures remain unchanged. This new study does not claim grokking, causal LM performance, or production savings.
